source.title: Phraesto - Misty Scorpion
source.name: Phraesto
source.description: A cunning Tank who is good at confusing enemies with powerful illusions.

skills.name: Futile Echo

description.raw: Passive: Phraesto sacrifices 12% of his max HP, summoning an identical Illusion during the preparation stage. This Illusion inherits 100% of Phraesto stats and can cast all his skills. When both Phraesto and his Illusion are positioned in the same row, they each receive a 30% damage reduction effect, lasting until one of them is defeated. Active: Phraesto deals 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to enemies within 2 tiles, recovering himself 160% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) HP for each enemy hit.
active: Passive: Phraesto sacrifices 12% of his max HP, summoning an identical Illusion during the preparation stage.
This Illusion inherits 100% of Phraesto stats and can cast all his skills.
When both Phraesto and his Illusion are positioned in the same row, they each receive a 30% damage reduction effect, lasting until one of them is defeated.
Active: Phraesto deals 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage to enemies within 2 tiles, recovering himself 160% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) HP for each enemy hit.

text: Unlocks at level 51: Increases the damage dealt to 240% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 111: Increases the damage dealt to 280% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 171: Increases the damage dealt to 320% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 231: Increases the damage dealt to 360% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Passive. Phraesto sacrifices max HP to summon an Illusion who can cast all his skills. Active. Phraesto deals damage to enemies nearby and recovers his HP for each enemy hit.

skills.name: Crimson Contract

description.raw: Phraesto and his Illusion each sign a permanent contract with different allied heroes placed 1 tile behind them when a battle starts, reducing the recipient's HP by 6%. Phraesto increases the recipient's Energy Recovery Speed by 14%, while the llusion increases the recipient's DMG Reduction by 14%. The terms of each contract remain undetected by enemies before the battle starts. Active: Phraesto launches 3 strikes against an enemy in front, dealing 100% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage with the first 2 hits and 140% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage with the 3rd hit.
active: Phraesto and his Illusion each sign a permanent contract with different allied heroes placed 1 tile behind them when a battle starts, reducing the recipient's HP by 6%.
Phraesto increases the recipient's Energy Recovery Speed by 14%, while the llusion increases the recipient's DMG Reduction by 14%.
The terms of each contract remain undetected by enemies before the battle starts.
Active: Phraesto launches 3 strikes against an enemy in front, dealing 100% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage with the first 2 hits and 140% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage with the 3rd hit.

text: Unlocks at level 71: Phraesto grants his recipient an extra 80 Energy.
The Illusion grants the recipient a 180% (ATK-based) shield for 6s.
Unlocks at level 131: Increases the damage of the 3rd hit to 210% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 191: Increases the damage of the 3rd hit to 280% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Phraesto and his Illusion each sign a permanent contract with different allied heroes positioned behind them at the start of every battle. Active. Deals damage to a frontal enemy 3 times.

skills.name: Vicious Sting

description.raw: Phrases to stings an enemy in front, dealing 50% (ATK-based) damage and inflicting them with Paralyzing Venom for 6s. Enemies afflicted with Paralyzing Venom have their Haste reduced by 30 and Vitality reduced by 45. They also lose 2% + 0.4% (SP-based) of their max HP per second, while restoring 3% of the caster's max HP per second. Enemy HP loss can't exceed 40% of Phraesto ATK per second.
active: Phrases to stings an enemy in front, dealing 50% (ATK-based) damage and inflicting them with Paralyzing Venom for 6s.
Enemies afflicted with Paralyzing Venom have their Haste reduced by 30 and Vitality reduced by 45.
They also lose 2% + 0.4% (SP-based) of their max HP per second, while restoring 3% of the caster's max HP per second.
Enemy HP loss can't exceed 40% of Phraesto ATK per second.

text: Unlocks at level 91: Increases the enemy's lost HP per second to 2.5% + 0.4% (SP-based) of their max HP.
Unlocks at level 151: Increases the max HP ratio restored per second for Paralyzing Venom's caster to 4.5%.
Unlocks at level 211: Increases the enemy's lost HP per second to 3.3% + 0.4% (SP-based) of their max HP.

skills.description_lite: Phraesto inflicts an enemy with Paralyzing Venom, making them lose HP constantly and reducing their stats.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Phraesto increases the Phys & Magic DEF of both himself and his Illusion by 30%. Whenever one of them loses 10% of max HP, the other gains 15 Energy.
active: Phraesto increases the Phys & Magic DEF of both himself and his Illusion by 30%.
Whenever one of them loses 10% of max HP, the other gains 15 Energy.

text: Phraesto increases the Phys & Magic DEF of both himself and his Illusion by 40%.
Whenever one of them loses 10% of max HP, the other gains 20 Energy.
Phraesto increases the Phys & Magic DEF of both himself and his Illusion by 50%.
Whenever one of them loses 10% of max HP, the other gains 25 Energy.

skills.description_lite: Phraesto increases the Phys & Magic DEF of both himself and his Illusion. Whenever one of them loses HP, the other gains Energy.

skills.name: Foggy Whisper

description.raw: Phraesto taunts the enemy who dealt the most damage if his Illusion is defeated before he is, dealing 500% (ATK-based) damage and stunning them for 4.5s.
active: Phraesto taunts the enemy who dealt the most damage if his Illusion is defeated before he is, dealing 500% (ATK-based) damage and stunning them for 4.5s.

text: Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 5: Increases the skill damage to 600% (ATK-based).
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 10: Increases the skill damage to 700% (ATK-based).
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 15: Phraesto summons a new Illusion in front of himself if the previous Illusion is defeated before he is.
The new Illusion inherits on 60% of Phraesto's max HP.
Triggers once at most per battle.

skills.description_lite: Phraesto deals damage to an enemy and stuns them if the Illusion is defeated before he is.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: When both Phraesto and his Illusion are positioned in the same row, they each receive a shield equal to 570% of their ATK when a battle starts, lasting up to 12s.
